title: SynAPSeg: A novel dataset and image analysis framework for deep learning-based synapse detection and quantification.
summary: SynAPSeg trained and evaluated StarDist segmentation using expert-annotated 2D/3D synaptic puncta; full Results report expert-level model performance and biological application mapping hippocampal PSD95, reproducing PV-intensity/synapse association and finding age-related PSD95 puncta-density reduction along PV dendrites. The imaging and sampled-region limits remain.
ai_technology: SynAPSeg applies StarDist deep-learning segmentation to identify synaptic puncta in annotated microscopy images.
